semantics.good: valid only for declared as_of and freshness window

unavailable.meaning: external revocation source unavailable or untrusted; not a certificate contradiction

revocation.authoritative_source: external CA/attestor revocation service or immutable owner-published CRL; absent currently
revocation.recovery: provide source URI or offline artifact, issuer/policy, as_of rule and independently verifiable signature

trusted_time.recovery: provide signed timestamp token and independent TSA policy/chain

anti_replay.canonical_binding: all required fields are covered by the signed canonical receipt bytes
rules: nonce must be unique within scope and replay window
sequence must be monotone per source/attestor scope
same idempotency key plus same canonical bytes may return the same result
same idempotency key plus changed bytes is conflict
expired or future-out-of-skew receipt is fail_closed

replay_window.recovery: owner publishes signed window and independent verifier confirms

input_change_rule: No rerun or synonymous AD while trust/revocation/time/replay inputs and their fingerprint are unchanged
